component_interface: Each scripts/component_*.py exports build(cfg) -> list of Blender objects; import geom_helpers. Use common world coords. Do not reset scene, add cameras, run render, or export in build(). Object names own prefix. Custom properties evidence_level/source_refs/registered_component_id where supported. No physics constraints or arbitrary animation.
